scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:30 definitions updated and70 retained. Restore native damage-history scanning for Thirsting Axe, graveyard selection for Faerie Macabre, Grim Flayer top-library selection, trigger dispatch, aura event filtering, Deep Water legacy creation, and token/target bookkeeping. Native quirks retained, including Sanctum of Ugin unused constructed filter, Queen Marchesa monarch condition and Chronostutter library handling. Original source names/interfaces are preserved. Full aligned owner assembly resolves damage-history field offsets/masks, Dynavolt energy descriptor and Inquisitor dialog commands; exact council option-copy bytes pinned.138 native callee identities,111 enum values,6 complete source dependency bodies and82 data ranges bound. Independent callees and gameplay remain separately tracked; no byte matching or whole-program equivalence claim.
